basis: Andrew, 5 Nov 2026 (09:0x AEST): "P17  leaving at 9am". 1268887 is P17's only unit (Coates portable building; ticked Ready 3 Nov; Brenden Meek's booking for 5 Nov 10:00 on the record; read 09:06 AEST, not already left), so P17 left in full at 09:00 AEST on Thu 5 Nov 2026, an hour before that booking. Its fire extinguisher stays listed on P17 as gear that goes with it. Recorded after 09:00, as a departure is only recorded once its time has come.
